# Pull Request

## Description
Briefly describe what this PR does. What problem does it solve?

## Related issue
Closes #(issue number, if applicable)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking, fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking, adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring (no behavioral change)

## Changes made
List the specific changes:
- [ ] Changed X to Y because...
- [ ] Added new function/plot/feature...
- [ ] Removed deprecated code...

## Biological/Statistical verification
For changes affecting analysis:
- [ ] Results validated against expected biological behavior
- [ ] Statistical methods reviewed (if applicable)
- [ ] Visualizations checked for accuracy
- [ ] Documentation updated to reflect changes

## Testing
How should reviewers test this?

**Steps to reproduce test:**
1. Clone this branch
2. Install packages (if dependencies changed)
3. Run the app
4. Navigate to [section]
5. Verify [expected behavior]

**Test with example data:** Yes / No

**Test with custom data:** Yes / No (type: bulk RNA-seq / single-cell / other)

## Screenshots or output
If UI changes, include before/after screenshots:

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines
- [ ] I have updated the README if needed
- [ ] I have commented complex sections, especially biological interpretations
- [ ] The app runs without errors or warnings
- [ ] All interactive elements work as expected
- [ ] I have tested with the example dataset
- [ ] I have tested with at least one additional dataset (if applicable)

## Breaking changes
Describe any breaking changes:
- Existing user workflows that would break
- Old code that no longer works
- Migration path for users

## Additional notes
Anything else reviewers should know?

---
Thank you for contributing! 🎉
